method: Actual overlay in Node VM with native HUD parent structure, DOM move semantics and mobile-live class transitions. Does not measure browser layout or pixels.

checks.name: Desktop docks existing controls into the native header/footer
Dock OFF restores all four native parents
Dock OFF restores native sibling order and event identity
Repeated docking does not duplicate nodes or lose event listeners
Fullscreen mobile restores controls outside hidden header/footer
Mobile effective docking does not overwrite user preference
Returning to desktop reapplies user-selected docking
User-disabled docking stays disabled across mobile transitions
Dock lifecycle leaves the overlay error ledger clear
